items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: I was in that one they had Joe Oliver... I was peeping in that window... I wasn't playing yet. I was just a youngster getting around

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I've heard that. Professor Vanetta talks about him a lot.

Yeah? Yeah. An old man Valtu. Yeah. Well, I'm telling you. He's down here. That's the one I heard. I was in that one they had Joe Oliver, that old man Valtu. I think they had about five pieces in there. Drums and whatever else they had. I don't know. Because I was peeping in that window like a transom I was looking. I was looking. I stand on top of a beer bell and something else. And the police had come and cracked me.
And I mean I hopped off that thing too quick for a hurry. Yeah.
